Hi Mrs Thompson,
It just made me so pleased, when out walking today I saw a little red robin in my yard and it had brought along its mate for some breakfast!
The robin is my absolute favourite so seeing that was a joy! 
Let your know when you are free and would like the same to take place at 4 pm.  

Take a good long rest this afternoon. Have fun and enjoy yourself.

Warm regards
